integrity.computer_checks: two reproducible finite programs; analytic proof is separate

scientific_limitations: Uniform real nonzero hopping and exactly two noninteracting identical bosons are assumed.
Every collision vertex has strictly positive irreversible loss; missing detectors and finite-time rates are outside scope.
The all-dimension results follow from an analytic Fourier proof; finite replay is corroboration, not exhaustive infinite verification.
Historical priority over unindexed equivalent analyses is not established.
title: Exact collision protection of two bosons on nonbinary Hamming networks
